title: Constraint: Exactly Three Equal Values
constraints: `arr` has 10 elements of 4 bits. Exactly **one** value appears exactly **3** times, and every other value appears at most **once**.
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: Add a helper `rand bit [3:0] rep;`: it's fine for the class to have extra random variables.
Any duplicate pair must be the repeated value: `(arr[i] == arr[j]) -> (arr[i] == rep)` for i < j.
